attributes.title: VAM27
attributes.summary:
The Society for Vascular Surgery holds VAM27 June 2 to 5, 2027, at the San Diego Convention Center, with the VQI meeting on June 1 and 2 and the Society for Vascular Nursing conference alongside. Registration and housing open March 3, 2027.

Early rates (March 3 to 24) are $995 for member surgeons and $1,825 for non-members, rising to $1,145 and $1,975 onsite. Reduced rates apply to residents, students and allied health staff.

SVS is ACCME-accredited and will offer AMA PRA Category 1 Credit and ABS self-assessment credit; the maximum will be posted when the program is final. Physician assistants receive a participation certificate they can use toward NCCPA requirements.
